profile.headline: Rails Engineer
profile.summary: My daily focus is on how I can bring more awareness and compassion to everything and everyone I encounter.  Mindfulness and meditation are my two driving forces.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the migration of marketing adapter creation to a UI-driven workflow, enabling project managers to build adapters. Reduced adapter creation time from several hours to ~15 minutes.
- Improved feature transparency by introducing a structured ticketing system, this boosted coordination among engineers and managers.
- Advocated for an incremental development process by encouraging small, focused PRs and preemptive test coverage, streamlining code reviews and mitigating regressions.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Code Review · Test Driven Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized team’s feature release process by adding ability to release features in the UI as opposed to merging and deploying pull requests.
- Spearheaded removal of subscription-based book collections feature while maintaining zero downtime deployments.
- Champion team best practices, thorough test coverage, and the consistent integration of new technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and wrote a query helper to allow easily adding time-zone specific date/time SQL queries. Implemented this helper in Arel to improve readability and composability.
- Unified application dashboard pages by streamlining prop serialization and improving component architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented a budget import system to allow client data migration from two fiscal intermediaries which resulted in over 20,000 budgets created.
- Created design docs for major features that were digested and developed by junior engineers.
- Advocated for code readability and test coverage while pushing forward planned feature work.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Checked in regularly with reports to understand their challenges, improve work experience, and provide opportunities to work on professionally fulfilling features.
- Developed resourcing plans to align with company goals while prioritizing manageable workloads.
- Led scrum rituals and encouraged thoughtful and solution-oriented communication.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented data migration to resolve client data entry error and regain over $80,000 in overpaid wages.
- Stabilized a bug-prone sick time eligibility and tracking system.
- Led electronic document integration with HelloSign API.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
